day_shape: 57 items: Majlis confirms Mehrdad Akhlaghi as defence minister with 237 votes, CENTCOM says 138 commercial vessels redirected under Iran port blockade, IRGC Navy claims two tankers struck mines in Hormuz, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: New Iranian defence minister confirmed
threads.summary: Iran's Majlis approved Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi as Defence and Armed Forces Support Minister by 237 votes to 15, ending interim leadership since February's killing of Aziz Nasirzadeh in US-Israel strikes. Regime outlets quoted Akhlaghi pledging an Iranian-made fighter jet next year, 85% defence outsourcing, and countermeasures to the US GBU-43 'mother of all bombs'.

threads.label: Hormuz maritime incidents and US blockade
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Rafael Peralta is transiting regional waters in support of a naval blockade of Iranian ports, with 138 commercial vessels redirected as of 17 October. The IRGC Navy claimed two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, and Defa Press cited UKMTO reports of a tug struck by two projectiles near Khorfakkan.

threads.label: Iranian threats toward US and Israel
threads.summary: SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei was quoted by regime channels saying Iran's armed forces have prepared a plan 'more destructive than the 12 and 40-day wars', while Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran 'will not bow to threats'. The Jerusalem Post reported the SNSC secretary threatening Israel and the US, and Netanyahu outlined 'destroying the Iranian threat' as a priority for a next term.

threads.label: Gaza, Lebanon and regional diplomacy
threads.summary: The IDF said four Hamas operatives, including an October 7 infiltrator, were killed in recent Gaza strikes, and condemned Israeli rioters who attacked diplomatic representatives near Taybeh. Lebanon said a military delegation will press for a halt to Israeli attacks at US talks, and Sisi said Egypt would defend Saudi Arabia if asked amid Houthi attacks.

threads.label: Internal Iranian pressures and opposition reporting
threads.summary: IRIB reported the Tehran stock index fell 84,819 points to 8.18 million, while Iran International covered Baluch militant attacks in the southeast, a Semnan sniper crackdown investigation, and bypass trade routes eroding Iran's transit role. A WFP October brief recorded 59,968 people assisted in September across five provinces affected by conflict.
